Yes — taken all together, this matches what I set out wanting. Saving a link and having it fill in the useful details on its own, fixing up the title and description, jotting a note with a bit of formatting, labeling things and finding them again through those labels and a real search that digs through everything, a separate read-later pile I can clear down, tucking old things away reversibly, deleting for good with a warning, and clicking through to the original without losing my collection — that's the whole picture I had in my head, and it hangs together well.

A couple of things I raised along the way I'll just want to see actually hold up as we go: search not caring about capital letters, and my labels nudging me toward existing ones as I type so I don't make duplicates. And one behavior we haven't touched yet that I'd expect to come up in those unusual cases: if I try to save a link I've already saved, I wouldn't want a second copy of it — I'd expect it to just take me to the one I already have so I can update it. So that's on my mind for what's next.

But as a whole, yes, this is my intent. Go ahead into the unusual and failure cases.
